headlines.title: Inside China’s flood devastation
headlines.description: The Chinese government allowed international journalists for the first time to see the flood devastation inside Tibet. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to ban Bombardier jet sales as Canada’s retaliatory tariffs take effect
headlines.description: President Donald Trump asserted Monday that the Canadian aerospace company Bombardier should no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the U.S., opening a new front in his trade war hours before new Canadian tariffs on American goods took effect.

headlines.title: New Hampshire primaries test Trump and the left
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s endorsement will be put to the test once again Tuesday in New Hampshire’s primaries, where liberal Democrats are also looking to cap an ascendant primary season with additional victories.

headlines.title: Cargo plane slams into vehicles killing 5 in Miami
headlines.description: The NTSB is investigating how an Amazon Prime branded cargo plane overran a runway and slammed into multiple vehicles. NBC News’ George Solis reports from Miami International Airport.

headlines.title: Get a First Look at Elizabeth Holmes Doc ‘You Can See Everything’
headlines.description: A trailer is out for “You Can See Everything,” a documentary directed by Nathan Fielder that focuses on Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes leading up to her imprisonment after she was convicted of fraud. Get a first look!

headlines.title: Hurricane Lowell barrels towards Hawaii
headlines.description: Hawaii has issued a statewide flood watch, as officials warn residents to stay home and off the roads. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports from Kauai.

headlines.title: King Charles says Harry and Meghan will not return as working royals
headlines.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex will still not be able to use the titles of His and Her Royal Highness and will remain private citizens, according to a letter sent on behalf of King Charles. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.description: This article is part of “Disabled and Denied,” a series examining cuts to Medicaid home care and the fallout for disabled people and their families.

headlines.title: Iran increases gasoline price for its heaviest consumers as economy struggles
headlines.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran early Tuesday introduced a higher price for its heaviest users of gasoline, state media reported, in the latest economic pinch caused by months of war.
